description: Local character formatting without a style for the characters start_index (inclusive) to end_index (exclusive) of the story of a text frame: font_style (exact InDesign style name – fetch it with get_font_info_at_index first, "75 Bold" rather than "Bold"; optional font_family to switch the family), swatch_name (an existing swatch, exact name; built-ins are "Black", "Paper", "None"), superscript (true/false), tracking (Laufweite in 1/1000 em, -1000 to 10000; the server configuration can set a tolerance beyond which a warning is given), point_size (0–1296, the only way to a size without a paragraph style), language (dictionary for hyphenation and spelling of the range, e.g. a foreign-language quotation – same names as in define_paragraph_style; check_typography rule foreign_language_in_text finds ranges whose language differs from their paragraph style). At least one attribute. Never changes text. Returns applied[], point_size_applied, font_family, font_style, fill_color and language {name, untranslated_name, icu_locale} read back at the first character for a cross-check, plus characters_affected. Stories managed by an editorial workflow (InCopy) that are not checked out here (lock_state checked_in_story, locked_story, missing_lock_state or mixed_lock_state) are refused before anything is written: invalid_state with details.code "story_locked" (details: frame_id, story_id, lock_state, managed_file) – check the story out in the editorial system or in InCopy first.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

end_index.description: End of the range (exclusive); must be greater than start_index.

font_family.description: Font family to switch to (optional; needs the font to be installed unless font_style is given too).

font_style.description: Exact style name within the family, e.g. "75 Bold".

language.description: Language of the text (Sprache, for hyphenation and spelling): the name InDesign shows (e.g. "Deutsch: 2006 Rechtschreibreform", "Englisch: Großbritannien"), its untranslated name as InDesign holds it ("English: UK", but "de_DE_2006" for German) or an ICU locale ("de_DE", "en_GB" – the safest form; where InDesign holds several dictionaries for one locale, the 2006 spelling reform is chosen and a warning names it); unknown names fail with not_found and the available list.

start_index.description: First character of the range (inclusive), a story index from get_frame_text.

superscript.description: true sets superscript, false resets to normal position.

swatch_name.description: Existing swatch name for the text colour.

name: apply_character_format_to_range
title: Format a range locally
